midnight_rope.name: Midnight Rope
midnight_rope.description: The bell rope worn smooth by thirty years of a single pair of hands. It is the only thing the Herald's ice will not touch.

old_chapel_key.name: Key of the Old Chapel
old_chapel_key.description: Cut from glacier ice that never melts. It opens the chapel beneath the Winterheart — and only from the outside.

founders_journal.name: Founder's Journal
founders_journal.description: The journal of Team Krampus's founder. The final entry is not about power at all: 'The bells are a promise we made to something ancient. Krampus is not a man. It is an office. And the office is tired.'

sixth_bell.name: The Sixth Bell
sixth_bell.description: The original Krampus Bell, recovered at last. Next to the five Frostbells it is silent — saving its voice.

winterheart_seal.name: The Winterheart Seal
winterheart_seal.description: The relic reforged from the Winterheart and the six bells. Warm as a heartbeat, and quiet for the first time in a thousand years.
